description: The image displays two side-by-side vertical bar charts illustrating Fleiss Kappa values across different ambiguity metrics. The left chart contains a horizontal category axis with a blurred label that appears to read "Ambiguity Std", displaying the numerical categories 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94 in ascending order. It contains four bars rendered in varying shades of blue, each annotated with its exact value above the bar. The tallest bar corresponds to category 0.0 with a value of 0.88, followed by category 0.47 at 0.46, category 0.94 at 0.24, and the shortest bar for category 0.82 at 0.03. The right chart features a horizontal category axis labeled "Max Ambiguity" with the numerical categories 1, 2, and 3 in ascending order. It contains three bars, also in varying shades of blue and annotated with exact values. The tallest bar in this chart is for category 1 with a value of 0.89, followed by category 2 at 0.46, and the shortest bar for category 3 at 0.23. In both charts, the bars are sorted according to the numerical ascending order of their respective horizontal axis categories, and visual emphasis is provided through the exact numerical annotations placed directly above each bar.
